features: Prevents water from coming out of the shower curtain
Keeps bathroom floors dry and safe
description: Tubb Tender is the original splash guards of it's kind. It is a great fix to the #1 bathroom accident, slipping and falling! It is easy to install and comes with everything you need. Tubb Tender is great for the do-it-yourselfer to fix your shower from leaking onto the floor inbetween the shower curtain and the wall. It is made in the USA!
